annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He must have trusted that display completely
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: expecting the side track to be clear when he made the switch

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I imagine he felt fairly confident flipping that switch
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: it was based on the only information he had
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people are alive because of his choice.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He likely expected, in that moment, that he was saving five
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: That expectation was reasonable given what was in front of him.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He probably believed, with real confidence, that the side track was empty.
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: When belief and reality diverge through no visible signal

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: his intention was to prevent five deaths
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: acting on the assumption that the track ahead was safe

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He almost certainly expected the diversion to be a clean save
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: it was built on the tool he was given to trust

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He seems to have believed he was choosing the lesser harm
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: going by the only signal available to him

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the operator likely felt certain, or close to it
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Since the flaw was hidden from him

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He probably assumed, based on what the screen told him
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: based on what the screen told him, that no one stood
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I can hold sorrow for the one lost
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people walked away because of the choice he made

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He appears to have expected a straightforward trade avoided
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: it wasn't unreasonable given what was shown to him
